messages:
Theo: Anyone up for a 'Snowflake Sticker + Emoji-Karma' swap? Leave a sticker, take an emoji-kudos in thread. :snowflake: :label:
Mina: Ooh yes. What's emoji-karma? Quick explainer: you give someone a custom emoji-reaction and a one-line compliment. Those count toward our winter kudos board. :sparkles:
Asha: I'll design 3 sticker sheets (retro, minimalist, silly). Vote with :one: :two: :three:. Also can do a tiny QR code to link to donor's name if they want.
Rob: MailOps: can the office accept anonymous sticker drops? Some folks prefer not to share addresses.
MailOps: HQ can accept pre-labeled envelopes. Use code `SF-SWAP-<slack>` or `INT-SWAP-<slack>`. We can't mail outbound internationally from HQ. Please use the sign-up sheet: http://tiny.redwood/snowflake-swap
Mina: Poll: prefer stickers or a small seed packet? React :snowflake: for sticker, :seedling: for seed.
Theo: Also idea: every emoji-kudos used in thread = 1 point. We'll tally and the top 3 get small plant prizes. I'll spin up a sheet to track.
SleighBot: Reminder scheduled: "Sticker Swap Dropbox opens" Mon 9:00 AM HQ. :bell:
Asha: Uploaded sticker mockups and a printable label PDF in #design. I'll post link later.
Rob: Sign-ups close Fri EOD. Remote folks, if you want a plant prize, please add shipping preference in the sheet. Cheers! :raised_hands:
